title: Bessie Smith's birth chart
metaDescription: Bessie Smith's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 25.7° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 25.7° Aries, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Aries, but precisely: 25.7°, third decan, 20°–30°, under Jupiter in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 28.6° Pisces; Venus stands at 10.1° Pisces; Mars stands at 12.9° Aquarius. The tradition reads a mind that absorbs before it argues from Mercury, taste tuned to mood and undertow from Venus, drive that argues its way forward from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Venus and Pluto: 0.8° from an exact square. Nothing in a square flows; everything in it works. The old texts kept squares for the charts they respected. Behind it, Mars square Uranus at 1.2°, and Mars trine Neptune at 1.3° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These angles were checked through every hour of that civil day and survive throughout, which is why an unrecorded hour does not disturb them.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has five entries for this chart. The Sun in Aries at 25.7° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Mercury in Pisces at 28.6° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Pisces at 10.1° is in exaltation; Jupiter in Gemini at 2.7° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Libra at 21.5° is in exaltation. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 5, water 3, fire 1; modalities mutable 5, cardinal 2, fixed 2. Air runs on comparison and connection — the pattern noticed first, the feeling filed second. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Leo into Virgo during that day at the birthplace, travelling 13.8° between one midnight and the next. Which of the two it was depends entirely on the hour, and the hour is not recorded. Rather than pick the likelier half, the reading leaves the Moon open.
